name: Warren Ellis Gentry

public.text:
I’m Warren Gentry, 54, a small-town attorney and part-owner of a local title business in rural West Tennessee. My ten main interests are: (1) local history and genealogy, (2) county and community affairs, (3) folk and classic country records, (4) small woodworking and farmhouse repairs, (5) gardening, (6) Southern home cooking, (7) local high-school football, (8) church and community service, (9) mentoring young people interested in law or public service, and (10) visiting regional historical sites with my wife.

2 — Very unlikely, but not impossible. I enjoy vegetables, but a cold tomato-based soup in a bottle isn’t something I’d ordinarily reach for. I might try a small one on a hot day if the price were reasonable.

justification: He said purchasing bottled gazpacho was very unlikely but not impossible, since it isn’t something he would ordinarily reach for, though he might try a small bottle on a hot day if reasonably priced.
